item.title: Jason Short Joins Orva to Grow Footwear Portfolio
item.description: Jason Short joins Orva as senior vice president, general merchandising manager, focusing on expanding the firm's athletic performance brand portfolio.

item.title: Department Stores Recast Menswear Around Casual, Sports and Experiences
item.description: Luxury’s slowdown and the shift to casual are pushing retailers to prioritize athleisure and events to sustain growth, according to a new IADS report.

item.title: Theory Men’s Fall 2026: New York Elegance Reimagined
item.description: Creative director Martin Andersson has injected more texture into the collection and introduced an elevated 2 Gansevoort capsule.

item.title: Goldwin Opens European Flagship at Former Veggie Pret Location in London
item.description: The Tokyo-based sportswear and outdoor brand envisions the space as the "eye of a vortex" amid the hustle and bustle of the city.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Lemme Launches Limited-edition Skin Glaze Gummies With Kylie Cosmetics
item.description: The chewy supplements will be sold exclusively at Ulta Beauty for a limited time only starting Sunday.

item.title: Deion Sanders’ Second Nike Sneaker Is Coming Back With Original Details for the First Time Since 1994
item.description: The Air Diamond Turf 2 reissue lands at retail in February.

item.description: The "City of Champions" colorway matches an upcoming Nike Kobe 1 Protro release.
